source.snapshotType: OSM map API retrieval time; no planet snapshot timestamp supplied
source.geometry: Real mapped road centerlines and building footprints; community map, not a topographic survey
source.simulation: Vehicle movement, scenario schedules and priorities are illustrative, not real-time or historical observations
source.note: Los jardines y las farolas son paisajismo representativo de muestra; no son límites de propiedad, un catastro de áreas verdes ni posiciones de luminarias levantadas en terreno. Los árboles sin altura medida utilizan una estimación visual de 7.2–8 m.
source.projection: WGS84 ellipsoid ECEF to local east/north tangent plane at center; x=east, z=-north, y=up; metres

query:
GET https://api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/map?bbox=-70.55035,-33.4500,-70.5475,-33.4476

OpenStreetMap public map API 0.6; WGS84 bbox order: west,south,east,north.
Downloaded 2026-11-03. The unmodified XML is sector-caracci.osm.
The map endpoint returns complete ways and their referenced nodes. Additional tagged nodes include real trees.

Overpass was attempted but timed out. No Overpass response is used for the active sector.

transform.coordinates: x east, z south, y up; all lengths in metres
transform.buildingRotation: Three.js rotation.y = -atan2(world-z edge, world-x edge), adjusted 90° if model footprint fits better rotated
transform.buildingFit: Minimum-area rotated OSM roof rectangle; detailed house mesh fills 91% of each plan dimension. uniformScale gives a representative 4–7 m height; scaleXZ adjusts horizontal axes moderately. Concave recesses are approximated instead of shrinking the whole house into a tiny inscribed rectangle. Road and neighboring-model intersections are rejected.
transform.facadeOrientation: Choose the 180-degree variant facing the nearest mapped driving road. This is illustrative, not observed facade orientation.
transform.modelReconstruction: Detailed downloaded meshes represent typologies. They do not replicate individual local facades or surveyed elevations.
transform.roadWidths: OSM width where present; otherwise lane count ×3.15 m +0.30 m or a declared highway-type estimate
transform.routing: Directed graph from shared original OSM nodes, limited to the public José Caracci and José Zapiola ways. Oneway=-1 reverses edges; one-way direction honored. Private/no-access ways and the southern condominium access excluded.
transform.vehicleLane: Right-side offset in travel direction; representative lanes, not surveyed lane markings. No spline across adjacent parcels.

geometryValidation.endpointNote: The first/last two samples are omitted from corner-envelope checks where vehicles enter/leave the map boundary.

visualReference.provider: Google Maps satellite, manually reviewed by the parent agent
visualReference.observations: T junction: José Caracci extends north from José Zapiola. Low-rise 1–2 storey houses, grey/beige/terracotta roofs and front gardens. Southern access belongs to private Condominio Los Cipreses; no invented continuation. No traffic signal observed from overhead imagery.
visualReference.use: Visual corroboration only; no Google imagery copied, packaged, or used as a texture.

limitations: No turn-restriction relations were requested in this small export; routes honor way direction and shared nodes, not every traffic regulation.
No live data or historical speed observations are used.
Widths and untagged building heights are estimates for demonstration.
Imported low-poly house meshes are representative typologies; roof envelopes and positions come from OSM, but facades are not surveyed reconstructions.
Garden trees marked as representative are decorative inferred planting, not a tree inventory. Mapped tree nodes retain their OSM IDs. No traffic signal is placed because none was verified.

Lawn rings extend an illustrative 3 m beyond house envelopes, clipped to pavement clearances and free gaps between neighbors. They do not denote real property boundaries. Four streetlights are a representative lighting sample, not verified locations.
